evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/account/account.service.ts:329-473 explicitly manages QueryRunner connect, SERIALIZABLE start, commit, rollback, and release around related-transaction and account deletion.
Both delete operations use repositories from queryRunner.manager, so they share one atomic transaction; unexpected processing/database failures map to the required safe HTTP 500 response.
Targeted backend ESLint and the Nest production build passed after Repair 003.
requirements.rationale: The current implementation uses the required QueryRunner lifecycle and rolls back the full atomic deletion on any unsuccessful step.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/account/account.service.ts:329-368 uses SERIALIZABLE isolation, locks the user and owned account, and checks the same QueryRunner transaction snapshot for a locked Pending transaction before any write.
The Pending branch throws the source-defined HTTP 409 ConflictException, so the transaction exits without deleting the account or transactions or changing User.total_balance.
Targeted backend ESLint and the Nest production build passed after Repair 002.
requirements.rationale: The current source rejects deletion on a locked Pending transaction before mutation and preserves unchanged state through transaction rollback.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/account/account.service.ts:333-447 locks the User row, deletes the account, and updates User.total_balance before the same QueryRunner transaction commits.

requirements.rationale: The current source synchronizes the persisted user total from all remaining owned accounts within the same locked atomic deletion transaction.
